##### Project general facts

The Haven is a beautifully conceived residential development of twin towers, joined together by a welcoming community centre and a grand entrance lobby. Every detail has been meticulously designed to engage the five senses, following biophilic design principles that nurture a natural connection to greenery, daylight and well-being. The development offers 322 residential units, ranging from cosy studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments, making it an inspired choice for anyone seeking a luxurious and healthy lifestyle.

Residents are spoilt for choice with a wonderful array of modern amenities, including a full suite indoor and outdoor gym, a spacious yoga studio and a peaceful reflection garden for quiet contemplation. A luxurious pool deck with separate pools for adults and children, a baja shelf, ample sun-loungers and refreshing outdoor showers creates a true oasis of relaxation, complemented by an upscale club house, a guest lounge with a picturesque outdoor terrace and generous indoor and outdoor play spaces for children. Thoughtful extras such as dedicated co-working spaces, electric vehicle charging stations, bicycle parking, solar-powered covered parking and around-the-clock security make everyday life effortless and sustainable.

Inside the apartments, the soft and muted colour palette of the facade continues seamlessly, creating interiors that feel calm, light-filled and quietly luxurious. Nature-inspired finishes, elegant kitchens, refined bathrooms and thoughtfully placed indoor greenery come together to give every home a sense of warmth and serenity. Layouts have been carefully optimised for ease of movement and flow, so that lounging, cooking and resting all feel wonderfully unhurried and comfortable.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district in Dubai. It is located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. Majan is a perfect place for those who are looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values. If you want to purchase an off-plan housing unit, you can count on a good discount.

With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road. These roads provide Majan strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels and mixed-use units.

The main advantage of Maijan is its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price.
